PropertiesSelection.description: A field the buyer sets by choosing options from the set the seller declares. `included[]` names the options in the base rate, `selected[]` the buyer's choice, which replaces it, and `deltas` the price of each option outside `included[]`, each by option id.

deltas.description: The price of an option outside `included[]`, keyed by option id. An option with no entry has no delta.

included.description: The options in the base rate, by option id.

max_select.description: The most options that may be in effect.

selected.description: The buyer's choice, by option id. It is the complete set in effect and replaces `included[]`.

allocation.description: `all` | `seller_allocated`. Absent means `all`. With `all`, the line item runs on every listed screen. With `seller_allocated`, the seller picks the screens: `screens[]`, when present, is the pool it picks from and is seller-set, and the proof-of-play log names the screens used

apps.description: The apps behind a property sold in `app_mobile` or `ctv` (§ 5.2.5)

child_audience.description: `directed` | `mixed` | `general`. `directed`: children are its primary audience under the law the seller applies, or its app store lists it for children only. `mixed`: directed to children but not as its primary audience, or listed for children and older users. `general`: neither. § 5.2.7 states what follows

child_treatment.description: `excluded` | `contextual`. `excluded`: users identified as children don't receive the line item. `contextual`: they receive it without personal data

domains.description: The property's domains. On a `dooh` line item, the inventory owner's domain, as OpenRTB 2.6 `dooh.domain`

min_screens.description: With `seller_allocated`, the fewest screens the seller allocates to the line item

seller_accounts.description: The accounts that sell the property

slots_per_loop.description: The slots per loop the line item buys on each screen of the property that has a `loop`

sync_groups.description: Screens that show the same ad at the same moment, sold as one (§ 5.2.8)

tv_channel.description: The TV channel or station the property carries, as an AdCOM 1.0 `Channel` object in AdCOM's keys and meanings. It SHOULD carry `domain`. Properties whose `tv_channel.domain` is the same carry the same channel, so a buyer can tell when two sellers offer it. Each seller assigns its own `id`, so `id` matches only within one seller

tv_network.description: The network that owns the property's channel, as an AdCOM 1.0 `Network` object in AdCOM's keys and meanings, matched by `domain` the same way

venue_type.description: `taxonomy` is a value of AdCOM 1.0 List: DOOH Venue Taxonomies. `ids[]` holds exactly one id. It covers only itself, not its descendants. The values OpenRTB 2.6 `dooh.venuetypetax` and `dooh.venuetype` carry

lat.description: Latitude, as OpenRTB 2.6 `geo.lat`. Absent when `movable` is true

lon.description: Longitude, as OpenRTB 2.6 `geo.lon`. Absent when `movable` is true

loop.description: Absent when the screen schedules ads without a loop

movable.description: True when the screen has no fixed location, as AdCOM 1.0 `Dooh.fixed` value 2 (movable)

screen_id.description: The seller's id for the screen, as its proof-of-play log carries it. When the bid request's `device.ifa_type` is `ppid`, as the OpenRTB 2.6 implementation guide (§ 7.9.2.5) uses it, `device.ifa` carries the same id

asi.description: As ads.txt field 1, Domain name of the advertising system

sid.description: As ads.txt field 2, Publisher's Account ID

min_screens_per_play.description: The fewest of the group's screens that must show a display for it to count as one play (§ 5.6.4)

screen_ids.description: The `screen_id` of each screen in the group

description: The OpenProposal `properties` module: the vocabularies, objects, unions, and constructor copies of § 5.2.4, § 5.2.6, § 5.2.7, and § 5.2.8.
